outcome: Location of umbilical cord at birth
cohort: Twelve patients with funic presentation, detected between 23 and 34 weeks of gestation, who received a cervical cerclage.
finding: None of the 12 patients who received a cervical cerclage for funic presentation experienced umbilical cord prolapse.
mod_finding: Eight patients delivered via cesarean section, and five patients delivered vaginally.
gest_age: Funic presentation detected between 23 and 34 weeks of gestation, with gestational age at delivery recorded for all cases.
